note: All in One Accessibility embeds a hosted third-party (Skynet Technologies) accessibility widget on every page via hook_library_info_build + hook_page_attachments (external script id aioa-adawidget). The accessibility FEATURES are remote; everything configurable locally is in the config object all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings (userid = licence token, colorcode, position [default bottom_right], widget_size [regularsize], aioa_icon_type [aioa-icon-type-1], aioa_icon_size, statement_link, custom size/position flags, nofreeversion). Settings UI /admin/config/development/all-in-one-accessibility/ada_compliance (route all_in_one_accessibility.admin.allinoneaccessiblity, permission all_in_one_accessibility_settings). There is NO config/install default, so the object does not exist until first saved. Since the widget is an external integration, all medium/hard cases are grounded in that local config object (never on the remote widget). Baseline: the config object is absent (unsaved); reset/cleanup delete it to restore that baseline.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with all_in_one_accessibility enabled, where do I configure the widget, which permission is required, and what config object stores the settings?
evals.expected_output: Configure at /admin/config/development/all-in-one-accessibility/ada_compliance (route all_in_one_accessibility.admin.allinoneaccessiblity), which needs the all_in_one_accessibility_settings permission. Settings are stored in the config object all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings.

evals.prompt: How does all_in_one_accessibility actually add the accessibility toolbar to my site — does the module implement the features itself?
evals.expected_output: No — it embeds a hosted third-party JavaScript widget from Skynet Technologies (skynettechnologies.com). hook_library_info_build() builds a library whose JS is that external script (with the licence token, colour and position in the query string, DOM id aioa-adawidget), and hook_page_attachments() attaches it to every page. The accessibility features run in the remote widget, not in this module.

evals.prompt: In all_in_one_accessibility, which config field holds the licence token, and what field/default controls where the accessibility button appears?
evals.expected_output: The licence token is stored in the 'userid' field of all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings. The button corner is the 'position' field (default bottom_right; other values like bottom_left, top_right, top_left). colorcode sets the colour and widget_size (default regularsize) the button size.

evals.prompt: On this site, in which corner is the All in One Accessibility widget configured to appear, and what licence token is set? Inspect the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings has position = bottom_left and userid = AIOA-EVAL-TOKEN-123 on this site.

evals.prompt: What widget/button size is All in One Accessibility currently configured to use on this site? Inspect the live configuration and give the value of the relevant field.
evals.expected_output: all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings:widget_size is 'oversize' on this site (colorcode is also set).

evals.prompt: Configure all_in_one_accessibility on this site: set the widget licence token (userid) to AIOA-LIVE-9090 and place the accessibility button in the top-left corner (position top_left). Apply it to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: In all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings set userid = 'AIOA-LIVE-9090' and position = 'top_left' (drush cset, or via the settings form). Verified against those two config values.

evals.prompt: I want the accessibility button that the All in One Accessibility module adds to sit in the bottom-left corner of my site instead of the default. Please make that change on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings:position to 'bottom_left' (drush cset all_in_one_accessibility.userid.settings position bottom_left, or choose Bottom Left on the settings form).
